title: oenothera fruticosa var. vera
intro: Oenothera fruticosa var. vera, commonly known as the western evening primrose, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Onagraceae family. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of western evening primrose include wound healing, anti-aging, and the treatment of skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
